# StackVibe UI full project metadata

## Package overview

- stackvibe-ui — monorepo root
- apps/docs — Next.js documentation platform
- apps/playground — interactive visual playground
- packages/ui — Core UI primitives
- packages/motion — Motion-driven components
- packages/three — 3D components

## Component inventory

- Button
- Card
- Input
- Badge
- SpotlightCard
- TextReveal
- Glass3DCard
- FloatingSphere

## Installation

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm --filter @stackvibe/docs dev
```

## Distribution philosophy

The core UI package stays lightweight and independent from the 3D and motion stacks. Additional packages are opt-in and maintain clear boundaries.
